title: Record that the chosen tests were run
statement: As a developer, I can tick a checklist step that says the chosen tests passed, with a link to the run, so the proof sits with the release while the results stay in our CI.
overview: Proposed addition. Quality deliberately says how something is verified and never whether it passed, and run records are already deprecated for that reason. A proof step keeps that stance and gives an agent a way to show its work.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A template can hold a step that names `release tests`, and it is copied like any other.
Ticking that step can record a link to the run.
No test result or pass or fail state is stored in the Saga, and nothing reads one to judge a release.
